verdict.rationale: Keycloak ships server-hosted user flows: self-registration and forgot-password are documented, and an account console lets users update their profile, change passwords, set up 2FA and manage sessions. The look and feel can be customized through themes, with internationalization, progressive profiling, terms-and-conditions actions and passkey UI also documented. These are hosted pages rather than embeddable components, which still satisfies the story's 'or hosted pages' wording. Missing for 10: in-depth evidence of theme customization (only headings are cited), an explicit description of the hosted login page itself, and independent hands-on corroboration of the sign-in and sign-up UI.
